title: NodeGround: A Node Classification Benchmark in the Graph Foundation Model Era
abstract: arXiv:2609.39673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a pretrained graph model replace training and tuning a separate predictor for each dataset? Answering this requires evaluating prediction quality alongside computational cost. We present NodeGround, a node classification benchmark that puts graph foundation models (GFMs) and dataset-specific supervised learning under a common evaluation framework. The benchmark spans 51 datasets and evaluates six GFMs alongside 15 supervised methods under two label-availability regimes. Shared data partitions, validation-only model selection, controlled hyperparameter searches, and multiple predictive metrics make comparisons systematic, while workflow measurements account for adaptation, training, tuning, and inference. The results favor carefully tuned graph neural networks overall. translated_title: NodeGround：图基础模型时代的节点分类基准
translated_abstract: 预训练的图模型能否取代为每个数据集单独训练和调优的预测器？回答这个问题需要同时评估预测质量与计算成本。我们提出了NodeGround，一个将图基础模型（GFMs）与数据集特定的监督学习置于统一评估框架下的节点分类基准。该基准涵盖51个数据集，在两种标签可用性场景下评估了六个图基础模型和15种监督方法。共享的数据划分、仅基于验证集的模型选择、受控的超参数搜索以及多种预测指标使比较具有系统性，同时工作流测量涵盖了适配、训练、调优和推理环节。结果总体上倾向于精心调优的图神经网络。当可用标签较多时，GraphPFN在Elo排名中达到第三位，但其相对优势随数据集特性而有显著差异。效率比较进一步（摘要此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出NodeGround节点分类基准，在51个数据集上将图基础模型与监督学习方法置于统一框架下系统评估，发现精心调优的图神经网络总体表现最佳。
en_tdlr: NodeGround is a node classification benchmark spanning 51 datasets that systematically compares graph foundation models with supervised methods, finding that carefully tuned graph neural networks perform best overall.
